competitiveAdvantages.title: Moat Protection
competitiveAdvantages.description: ASML's proprietary lithography technology provides a strong barrier to entry for competitors, protecting its market position.

competitiveAdvantages.title: High Barriers to Entry
competitiveAdvantages.description: The complexity and capital intensity of ASML's equipment make it difficult for new players to enter the market.

competitiveAdvantages.title: Network Effects
competitiveAdvantages.description: ASML's dominance in the semiconductor manufacturing industry creates a self-reinforcing network effect, with more customers using its technology leading to increased demand.

investmentRisks.title: Valuation Concerns
investmentRisks.description: ASML's high P/E ratio and dependence on capital expenditures for growth may indicate overvaluation.

investmentRisks.title: Technological Disruption
investmentRisks.description: The shift to EUV lithography technology poses significant risks due to its complexity, cost, and potential for disruption in the semiconductor industry.

investmentRisks.title: Competition from EUV Technology
investmentRisks.description: New entrants like Canon and ASYIXT may challenge ASML's dominance with EUV lithography, potentially eroding market share.
